shared_elements: a disc/circular form (central medallion in A; bowl/rosette-like disc held in B)
justification: The only correspondence is generic: both surfaces are low reliefs that include an anthropomorphic form and a rounded disc-like element, features any tradition could produce independently. A is a radial star/rosette composition with a single figure enclosed in a central medallion, while B is a pair of elaborately robed, bearded/coiffed figures facing each other in profile, one extending a bowl, over long horizontal bands of inscribed text \u2014 wholly different subject, relationships and layout.
